name: firebase-security-rules-auditor
author: Google (Firebase)

newRules.title: Firestore and Storage rules are tested as code
newRules.text: Rules take authority (`role`, `isAdmin`, `ownerId`) only from `request.auth` or server-written documents, never from `request.resource.data`; `update` is at least as strict as `create`, so a document can't be created valid and then updated into an escalated state; every written field is type-checked and size-limited; `hasOnly()` / `diff()` are always paired with an ownership check. Emulator tests (`@firebase/rules-unit-testing`) cover, per collection, the denied path and a create-then-escalate attempt (TEST-2).
newRules.modeReason: security floor ("ownership") — never relaxed in quick mode

notes: Vendor skill (Apache-2.0), prompt-only; written as a red-team persona prompt, which this standard's instruction-file rule avoids — distilled instead of pinned.
rationale: Vendor checklist for Firestore/Storage rules, which the standard did not cover (SEC-8 is Postgres RLS). Distilled into FB-3 rather than pinned because the skill is a red-team persona prompt, which the instruction-files rule avoids.
